messages:
Ana (docs): Hey @Maya @Ethan — my docs PR (#4237) is blocked by the preview. Netlify link reports a linkcheck + an example that uses `timeout_ms` which I thought was removed. Can runtime confirm current API default for streaming timeouts and whether we should show `AbortController` in the JS snippet?

deploy-bot: Deploy preview 4237 — build failed. Linkcheck error: broken anchor /api/v1/streaming#timeouts (HTML 404). Logs: https://deploy.example/4237/logs

Maya (runtime): I can dig in. Short answer: runtime enforces a server-side stream timeout default of 120s for hosted. The JS/SDK used to accept `timeout_ms` client-side but that param was removed in SDK v1.3.0 in favor of using `AbortController`/cancellation. Which SDK version is the snippet showing?

Ana (docs): The snippet in the PR is copied from an older example and currently shows `redwoodClient.generate({ model: 'rwd-small', prompt, timeout_ms: 30000 })`. I updated the package.json in the docs site to show `@redwood/sdk@1.2.0` last week (oops).

Ethan (devex): We should update the example to use `AbortController` — it's the recommended pattern and avoids implying a removed param. Also recommend explicitly documenting server-side defaults (120s) and how to override client-side via Abort.

Ana (docs): Sounds good. One wrinkle: Ben, do you know if Dedicated or older pools have different server-side defaults? I remember a customer hitting 60s previously. If we assert 120s in docs we need to be precise about Dedicated/back-compat.

Ben (serving): Good catch. Historically Dedicated pools (legacy configs) used 60s. We rolled a standardization in Feb to 120s for new Dedicated pools, but some long-lived Dedicated customers still have 60s until they opt into the new profile. So hosted = 120s, Dedicated = usually 120s but could be 60s on legacy configs. We should add a clear note and mention contacting support/SE for exceptions.

Maya (runtime): I'll add a short runtime note saying "Hosted defaults to 120s; Dedicated may be 60s for legacy pools — check your deployment profile or contact support." That should unblock the docs wording.

Ana (docs): Great — I'll update the snippet to use AbortController and change the SDK version in the example to v1.4.0. Also removing `timeout_ms` usage. After that I need a reviewer from docs to approve; @Mira can you take it?

Mira (docs): Yep, I can review after you push the snippet change. Quick checklist for me: 1) update snippet + SDK version, 2) add note about hosted vs dedicated timeouts, 3) fix the broken anchor in the streaming page (looks like the heading id changed). If CI/preview passes I can approve and merge.

Ethan (devex): Minor suggestion — include an inline code example of AbortController usage for streaming + small comment about how SDK streaming responses will abort gracefully. Keeps it actionable.

Ana (docs): Will do. Holding merge until runtime note + snippet update + passing preview. ETA: I'll push changes in ~45m.

Maya (runtime): 👍 I'll follow up if we need to adjust anything else on the runtime docs page (anchor rename).

deploy-bot: Build queued for deploy-preview 4238.

Mira (docs): Thanks everyone — ping me here when 4238 passes and I'll give a final pass. :thumbsup:
